name: com.psilab.splatxr
description: Toolkit for developing AR/VR applications with 3D Gaussian splatting. Homepage, documentation and paper: (https://splatxr.github.io). Part of the UIST '26 paper "SplatXR: A Toolkit for Multi-Layered Extended Reality via On-Headset 3D Gaussian Splatting". Created by Princeton's Situated Interactions Lab. Authors: Cyrus Vachha, Mohamed Kari, Parastoo Abtahi. MIT License.
